lesson_fields.title: Surface Area and Volume of Solids
lesson_fields.summary: Surface area and volume of cubes, cuboids, cylinders. Use π for circular cross-sections.
lesson_fields.summary_fr: Aire latérale/ totale et volume de cubes, parallélépipèdes, cylindres. Utiliser π pour les bases circulaires.
lesson_fields.content:
## Key formulas

1. Cube: SA = 6a², V = a³.
2. Cuboid: SA = 2(lw + lh + wh), V = lwh.
3. Cylinder: CSA = 2πrh, TSA = 2πr(h + r), V = πr²h.
lesson_fields.content_fr:
Formules clés

1. Cube : AT = 6a², V = a³.
2. Parallélépipède : AT = 2(lw + lh + wh), V = lwh.
3. Cylindre : AL = 2πrh, AT = 2πr(h + r), V = πr²h.
